dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト); uses MCP (Message Control Program) interface typical of JMA ORCA/GnuCOBOL environment
evidence: JMA Open Source License in header comment

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software - monthly statistics parameter explanation screen (月次統計パラメータ説明画面)
purpose.summary: This program (ORCGG03) is a screen handler for the monthly statistics parameter explanation screen within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It manages initialization, screen transitions, parameter display/update, and interaction with the toukeimemo (statistics memo) database table. It is part of the G01/G03 screen group handling statistical report configuration.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (33 copybooks) for JMA ORCA framework
MCP (Message Control Program) interface for screen/event handling
LINKAGE SECTION with MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA
EVALUATE on MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT for event-driven screen logic
Database access via MCPDATA.INC (PostgreSQL via MCP, not EXEC SQL)
Japanese text in comments (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS encoded, decoded as latin-1)
SPA (Scratch Pad Area) pattern for inter-program communication
No COMP-3 usage; uses BINARY for path fields
verdict.notes: Source file contains Japanese comments encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, decoded here as latin-1 resulting in mojibake. This is a genuine production program from the open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. The MCP interface is ORCA-specific and resembles CICS in structure but runs under GnuCOBOL on Linux. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 56580 bytes total.
